name: redeemdex
description: RedeemDex browser extension and local Pokémon TCG Live redemption mock.

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:mock
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:extension:firefox && npm run build:extension:chrome
scripts.dev:extension: concurrently --kill-others "vite build --watch --mode firefox --config extension/vite.ui.config.ts" "vite build --watch --mode firefox --config extension/vite.background.config.ts" "vite build --watch --mode firefox --config extension/vite.content.config.ts"
scripts.check: biome check . && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:extension && npm run typecheck:mock
scripts.publish:firefox: npm run build:extension:firefox && dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 sign --source-dir extension/dist/prod/firefox --channel=listed --amo-metadata extension/amo-metadata.json --api-key="$WEB_EXT_API_KEY" --api-secret="$WEB_EXT_API_SECRET"'
scripts.publish:chrome: npm run build:extension:chrome && dotenv -e .env -- chrome-webstore-upload --source extension/dist/prod/chrome
